rules.unit: Entire sequence; no token labels edited; original IDs and records preserved.
limitations: All samples remain unreviewed. Unmatched LID errors can remain.
Global unreviewed status alone does not flag every sample.
Philippines is quarantined in full because its detector mapping remains provisional.
Filtering may bias short-burst and duration distributions.
Real single-language samples are not automatically quarantined.
Model disagreements are uncertainty, not adjudicated errors.
